name: word-huge
description: 单词钩子：一词占满画面（8vh 级大字 + 发丝线 + 注释行）
css: #tpl-word-huge { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .wh-hair { width: 64px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; opacity: .85; margin-bottom: 3.2vh; transform-origin: left center; } .wh-word { font-size: 13vh; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); max-width: 84%; } .wh-note { font-size: 2.3vh; opacity: .7; margin-top: 3vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); }
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .wh-hair", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out" }, {start});if (window.SplitText) { var _wh = new SplitText("{tpl} .wh-word", { type: "chars" }); tl.from(_wh.chars, { y: 110, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.07 }, {start} + 0.25);} else { tl.fromTo("{tpl} .wh-word", { y: 60, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.out" }, {start} + 0.25);}tl.fromTo("{tpl} .wh-note", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.45 }, {start} + 0.9);
